test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In January 2023, three Indian-origin researchers were among nine scientists named recipients of the Blavatnik Awardsfor Young Scientists in the UK. Which of the following is NOT one of these three scientists?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gagandeep Kang**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In January 2023, three Indian-origin researchers were among the nine scientists named recipients of the Blavatnik Awards for Young Scientists in the UK.
 
• The three Indian-origin scientists awarded are Mehul Malik, Rahul R Nair, and Tanmay Bharat.
 
• Mehul Malik is recognized for his work in quantum physics.
 
• Rahul R Nair is known for his significant contributions to the field of material science.
 
• Tanmay Bharat has made notable advancements in the area of structural biology.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blavatnik Awards for Young Scientists:**

 
 
• Established by the Blavatnik Family Foundation and administered by the New York Academy of Sciences.
 
• Aim to recognize and celebrate exceptional young scientists and engineers.
 
• Provide significant unrestricted funding to support their research.
 
• Categories include Life Sciences, Physical Sciences & Engineering, and Chemistry.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Awards:**
 
 
• Highlight the critical contributions of young scientists to global knowledge.
 
• Encourage continued innovation and advancement in various scientific fields.
 
• Help recipients gain broader recognition and support for their work.
 
 
 
• **Criteria for Selection:**
 
 
• Nominees must be 42 years old or younger.
 
• Evaluation based on quality, novelty, and impact of research.
 
• Consideration of future potential of the scientist’s work.
 
 
 
• **Other Notable Recipients:**
 
 
• Includes leading researchers and innovators from prestigious institutions worldwide.
 
• Past recipients have made groundbreaking contributions in their respective fields.
